name: Ambest Group Berhad
overview: Ambest Group Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所 ACE Market 上市，并收购了一处位于 Pulau Pinang 的物业，以支持其精密加工业务。公司业务线未发生重大变化，仍专注于半导体行业的 CNC milling、CNC turning、sheet metal fabrication 和 sub-modular assembly 服务。
overview_en: Ambest Group Berhad listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026 and acquired a property in Pulau Pinang to support its precision machining operations. There were no major changes to the business lines, which continue to focus on CNC milling, CNC turning, sheet metal fabrication, and sub-modular assembly services for the semiconductor industry.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成 IPO 并在 ACE Market 上市，同时收购物业用于业务运营。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market in 2026, and acquired a property for business operations.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Ambest Technology Sdn Bhd 以现金 RM1,950,000 收购位于 Pulau Pinang 的一处物业（包括土地及两层店屋），以扩大运营场所。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Ambest Technology Sdn Bhd acquired a property (land and a two-storey shophouse) in Pulau Pinang for a cash consideration of RM1,950,000 to expand its operational premises.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") OF ORDINARY SHARES IN AMBEST GROUP BERHAD ("AMBEST" OR "COMPANY") ("SHARES") IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING
actions.text: 公司进行首次公开募股（IPO），公开发行110,000,000股新股，并在马来西亚交易所 ACE Market 上市。
actions.text_en: The company conducted an initial public offering (IPO) of 110,000,000 new shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia.
